newsitem.title: SPAIN: Diplomatic row no obstacle for generous Catalans.
newsitem.headline: Diplomatic row no obstacle for generous Catalans.

text.p: Oblivious to a serious diplomatic row between Spain and Cuba, the town of Sitges is donating what it says is the most magnificent Catalan gift ever to the impoverished Caribbean island -- 350 used garbage bins.

The Sitges present to the people of Cuba was announced on Friday, three days after months of diplomatic tension between Madrid and Havana erupted into a full-fledged crisis over Spain's hard line against communist Cuban leader Fidel Castro.

"Sitges townhall has decided to carry out this act of solidarity in view of the critical economic situation afflicting the Cuban people and of the strong historical ties between this town and the Caribbean island," a municipal statement said.
Sitges's centre and seafront promenade are full of houses built by Catalans who emigrated to Cuba and came back wealthy.
The statement said the second-hand garbage bins were "the most significant aid provided to Cuba by any Catalan town."
